/* 이메일 채널 */ SELECT 'EML' AS SNDNG_GBNCD , E.SNDNGR_ID , E.MSG_ID , E.RCVR_ID , NVL(E.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN E.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) AS SNDNG_STSCD , NVL(E.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM) AS SNDNG_DTTM , CASE WHEN NVL(E.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN E.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'SCS' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SNDNG_YN , E.SNDNGNM , NULL AS SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_EML_SNDNG E INNER JOIN TB_LMS_MSG MSG ON E.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND 'EML' IN
#{gbn}
AND TO_DATE(NVL(E.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') >= TO_DATE(#{sndngSdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_DATE(NVL(E.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= TO_DATE(#{sndngEdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 - 1/86400
UNION ALL /* 모바일 채널 (PUSH/ALIM_TALK/SMS/LMS) */ SELECT M.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD AS SNDNG_GBNCD , M.SNDNGR_ID , M.MSG_ID , M.RCVR_ID , NVL(M.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN M.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) AS SNDNG_STSCD , NVL(M.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM) AS SNDNG_DTTM , CASE WHEN NVL(M.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN M.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'SCS' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SNDNG_YN , M.SNDNGNM , M.SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_MBL_SNDNG M INNER JOIN TB_LMS_MSG MSG ON M.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND M.MBL_SNDNG_TYCD IN
#{gbn}
AND TO_DATE(NVL(M.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') >= TO_DATE(#{sndngSdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_DATE(NVL(M.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= TO_DATE(#{sndngEdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 - 1/86400
UNION ALL /* 쪽지 채널 (SNDNG_STSCD 기반: SCS=성공, RJCT=수신거부, RSRV=예약, CNCL=취소) */ SELECT 'SHRTNT' AS SNDNG_GBNCD , S.SNDNGR_ID , S.MSG_ID , S.RCVR_ID , NVL(S.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) AS SNDNG_STSCD , NVL(S.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM) AS SNDNG_DTTM , CASE WHEN NVL(S.SNDNG_STSCD, CASE WHEN S.SNDNGYN = 'Y' THEN 'SCS' ELSE 'RSRV' END) = 'SCS' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SNDNG_YN , S.SNDNGNM , NULL AS SNDNG_PHNNO FROM TB_LMS_MSG_SHRTNT_SNDNG S INNER JOIN TB_LMS_MSG MSG ON S.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND 'SHRTNT' IN
#{gbn}
AND TO_DATE(NVL(S.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') >= TO_DATE(#{sndngSdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TO_DATE(NVL(S.SNDNG_DTTM, MSG.RSRV_SNDNG_SDTTM), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= TO_DATE(#{sndngEdttm}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 - 1/86400

0) AS SHRTNT_FAIL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SHRTNT' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'RJCT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SHRTNT_REJECTED_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SHRTNT' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'RSRV' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SHRTNT_RESERVED_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SHRTNT' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'CNCL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SHRTNT_CANCELED_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'EML' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD NOT IN ('RSRV', 'CNCL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EML_TOTAL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'EML' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'SCS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EML_SUCC_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'EML' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD IN ('FAIL', 'RJCT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EML_FAIL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'ALIM_TALK' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD NOT IN ('RSRV', 'CNCL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ALIMTALK_TOTAL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'ALIM_TALK' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'SCS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ALIMTALK_SUCC_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'ALIM_TALK' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD IN ('FAIL', 'RJCT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ALIMTALK_FAIL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD NOT IN ('RSRV', 'CNCL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SMS_TOTAL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'SCS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SMS_SUCC_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'SMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD IN ('FAIL', 'RJCT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SMS_FAIL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'LMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD NOT IN ('RSRV', 'CNCL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LMS_TOTAL_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'LMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD = 'SCS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LMS_SUCC_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CH.SNDNG_GBNCD = 'LMS' AND CH.SNDNG_STSCD IN ('FAIL', 'RJCT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LMS_FAIL_CNT FROM (
) CH INNER JOIN TB_LMS_MSG MSG ON CH.MSG_ID = MSG.MSG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON MSG.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SC.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_MSG_RCV_TRGTR TRGTR ON CH.MSG_ID = TRGTR.MSG_ID AND CH.RCVR_ID = TRGTR.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1
